text:
natalie: Quick heads-up 1: our path->method mapping in the REST gateway is causing quota misses for the /v1/infer endpoint. Some tenants hit 429s but the gRPC service shows low counts.

raj: Sounds like the gateway's transcode isn't preserving the method label that the quota service expects. Do you have an example mapping?

natalie: Example mapping in the gateway config:```yaml
- match: POST /v1/infer
  to: InferenceService.Infer
```
No header injection at the moment.

tasha: Two options: (A) gateway emits a signed header (X-Proto-Method) so downstream quota/metrics can key off the canonical RPC; (B) perform quota lookup after transcode inside the gRPC stack using canonical descriptors. A is quicker to ship.

drew: If we inject a header we must ensure auth can't be bypassed. Gateway should sign the header or set it internally-only so clients can't spoof. Also update the quota service to prefer header but fall back to path for a while.

selena: From console side: we need both dimensions visible. Add labels: `inbound_path` and `canonical_method` to the metrics so product and support can reconcile numbers. Also add a toggle in the Route detail UI to choose which key is "source of truth" for billing/alerts.

natalie: Proposed rollout: 1) Gateway: inject `X-Canonical-Method` for transcode routes behind a 5% canary. 2) Metrics: add labels `canonical_method` and `ingress_protocol=transcoded` for sampling. 3) Console: opt-in toggle per route + migration docs. 4) After 3 weeks and parity check, flip quota enforcement to use canonical method.

raj: Add an integrity check: gateway sets header and also emits a signed HMAC header `X-Method-Signature` that quota service validates using our shared key. That prevents spoofing.

drew: Agree. Also add an alert: if canonical_method counts differ from ingress_path counts by >10% during canary, fire a pager and capture sampled request payloads for inspection.

quota-bot: quota-service: canary rules applied to /v1/infer routes (5% tagging). Logs shipping to telemetry-raw for parity analysis.

selena: UI note: "Switching quota key might create transient billing or alert deltas. Use gradual rollout and monitor tenant diffs." Put that text next to the toggle.

natalie: I'll open the RFC and link the checklist: config changes, HMAC key rotation, metrics labels, console flag, alerts, and a post-mortem template in case we see regressions.

raj: Heads-up re: proto evolution: new RPCs might have multiple method names or overloads. We should map full descriptor (service + method) not just the short name.

drew: Also consider retention: if we add `canonical_method` as a high-card label, we should sample aggressively for the first month then cap cardinality for long-term storage. Put `protocol=transcoded|grpc` label to help apply retention policies.

selena: Will coordinate dashboard changes and add a comparison panel for "ingress_path vs canonical_method" with per-tenant delta heatmap.

natalie: Thanks team. No objections? If not, I'll kick off tickets and schedule the canary for tomorrow morning. :rocket:

raj: No objections. Please tag infra for HMAC key provisioning.

quota-bot: action: created ticket INFRA-1429 for method-signing keys.

natalie: Perfect. Closing this thread, will link the RFC when ready. :+1:
